description: This file defines utility functions for file synchronization and persistence in JSON format within the Utils namespace. It provides methods to sync a file to disk and to persist JSON settings into a file.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A wrapper class from WPEFramework::Core namespace used for file operations.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes a file to disk by opening it, flushing its buffer, and calling fsync to ensure data is written to disk.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists JSON settings to a specified file, updating a key with a JSON value, and ensures the file is synced to disk afterward.

ctags.name: persistJsonSettings
ctags.pattern: /^inline void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile, const string strKey, const JsonValue& jsVa/
ctags.signature: (const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
